description: The clocks are lies and the sirens stopped working, so the shift workers pay a human alarm. Bang on doors through Marrow Street, then rouse Voss Avenue before the whistle. Dodge what they throw. 10₵.
name: Human Alarm

emotes: {who} hammers a door in Marrow Street and bellows the time, which is a guess.
{who} works down the row of doors, knocking, ducking a flung boot without breaking stride.
{who} rattles a shutter and yells 'SHIFT! SHIFT!' until something inside groans awake.
{who} kicks the base of Voss Avenue flophouse and shouts everyone up for the line.
{who} drags a stick along the railings, a one-person wake-up call, deeply hated.
{who} counts the muffled curses from inside and marks each one as 'awake, technically.'
